response.justification: Bogdan Szabo lacks the core C++ expertise and industrial automation focus required for the role. His resume primarily highlights web and mobile development (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Ember.js) with limited C++ experience (only brief exposure at National Instruments). He also has no demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or high-performance systems typical of automation machinery. While his technical breadth and open-source contributions are notable, they do not align with the role's specialized requirements.
strengths: Strong full-stack development skills across multiple languages and frameworks
Active involvement in open-source projects and community contributions
Experience with performance optimization and system design in various domains
concerns: Limited C++ experience (only ~6 months at National Instruments, primarily with C)
No evidence of industrial automation, IoT, or cloud platform experience relevant to the role
Lacks exposure to secure development lifecycle practices (IEC 62443) or high-performance systems

key_factors.factor: Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) and IEC 62443 compliance
